sentences.text: The instant application filed challenging the order dated 08.08.2018 whereby the charges have been framed against the applicants herein.

On 09.05.2019, this Court passed the following order :
"Vakalatnama filed by Sri Rajesh Kumar Singh, Advocate on behalf of opposite party no. 2, is taken on record.

Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned counsel on behalf of opposite party and learned A.G.A. for the State.
This petition under Section 482, Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing/stay the entire criminal proceedings as well as impugned order dated 08.08.2018 passed by Chief Judicial Magistrate, Banda in Case No. 2212 of 2012 (State Vs. Fakhruddin & others)
arising out of Case Crime No. 451/12, under sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC & 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Banda.

It is contended by learned counsel for the applicants that the applicant no. 1 is Father-in-law, applicant no. 2 is Mother-in-law, applicant nos. 3 and 4 are Married Nanad and applicant nos. 5 and 6 are the unmarried Nand of the opposite party no. 2 have been falsely implicated in the present case by the opposite party no.2 on the general allegations, which is against the well settled principles of law as laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court reported in 2012 (10) SCC 741 in the matter of Geeta Mehrotra and another Vs. State of Uttar Pradesh.

All the submission made at the bar relates to the disputed question of fact, which cannot be adjudicated upon by this Court in exercise of power conferred under Section 482 Cr.P.C..

The modification/correction application is allowed and paragraph nos. 5, 7 & 10 of the order dated 9.5.2019 are deleted and in its place the following order is passed and the same shall be read as such.
"Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that the applicant no.1 to 6 have already been granted bail by the court below, hence they need not to appear again and apply for bail.

In view of the above submission of he learned counsel for the applicants, it is provided that the applicants shall appear before the court below in the aforesaid case through their counsel as and when required, but rest of the conditions shall remain the same."

Accordingly the modification/Correction application stands disposed off."
5.
Therefore, from the record, it is clear that the instant application has already been dismissed by this Court qua the applicant nos.1 to 4.

This application is entertained only for the applicant nos.5 &
6.

Learned counsel for opposite party no.2 has raised a preliminary objection that the applicants had approached this Court number of times, initially by filing Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No.12973 of 2012, which was disposed of by order dated 10.09.2012.

"Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

sentences.text:
This petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is directed against the proceedings registered in case no. 2212 of 2012 and charge sheet arising out of case crime no. 451 of 2012 under Section 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC read with 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Kotwali Nagar,
Banda, P.S. Kotwali Nagar, District Banda.
The matter was referred to the mediation cell of the court below, however, the mediation did not materialize into a compromise, as such, the case has come up before this Court today.

On a specific query being made by this Court about continuing with marital relationship between petitioner no. 1 and respondent no. 3,
the counsel appearing for the respective parties on the basis of instruction satisfactorily replied that petitioner no. 1 and respondent no. 3 i.e husband and wife are willing to live peacefully with each other.
It may be noted that marriage between petitioner no. 1 and respondent no. 3 took place in they year 2006 and they have a son aged about 7 years out of the said wedlock.

The parties regret about their past conduct of having resorted to Rajjak Ali And 5 Ors vs State Of U.P. And Anr on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104573088/
4 unwarranted proceedings against each other, which appears to have been done under some misunderstanding.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Now at this stage, respondent no. 3 who is legally wedded wife of petitioner no. 1 has also sought her transfer close to the residential place of her in-laws i.e. her husband and is willing to join the said institution in the capacity of teacher.
The petitioner no. 1 assures that he shall not allow his wife to be subjected to any kind of mental or physical torture.
In view of the undertaking, counsel for respondent no. 3 also states that the criminal proceedings having been taken up against the petitioners may be kept in abeyance and dropped.

Respondent no. 3 shall make an application before the competent authority for being allowed to join at the transferred place in compliance of the order dated 13.07.2012,
which according to the learned counsel was not acted upon because of the aforesaid FIR and she was also allowed to work at the previous place of her posting.
The concerned authority on being approached, shall take a sympathetic view of the matter as regards relieving respondent no. 3 in compliance of the transfer order dated 13.07.2012.

Since the parties have decided to lead their marital life peacefully with each other,
therefore, it is directed that a joint affidavit to this effect be filed by petitioner no. 1 and respondent no. 3 before the court below and on an affidavit being filed, the court below shall pass appropriate orders for dropping the proceedings of case crime no.451 of 2012 under Section 498A, 323,504,506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act.
Such order shall be passed by observing the conduct of parties for a period of six months.

On filing joint affidavit before the court below within a period of 15 days from today,
respondent no. 3 shall be free to accompany with her husband and both shall live peacefully alongwith other family members at the residence of petitioner no. 1.

With these observations, the petition is disposed of. "
7.

Again, an application under Section 482 Cr.P.C No.14280 of 2015 (Fakharuddin and 6 others vs.
State of U.P. and 2 others) was filed, which was dismissed vide order dated 03.01.2018.

sentences.text: Again, the instant application has been filed after framing of the charges.
8. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that in the instant case, the trial court has framed charges against all the applicants in mechanical manner without application of mind.

Learned counsel for the applicant further submits that from the plain reading of the FIR, there is not even a single allegation against the applicant nos.5 & 6 except the general and vague allegation of demand of dowry, which was prior to the marriage, of Rs.2 lacs and motorcycle and other articles, was made,
which was complied with by the father of the opposite party no.2.
Therefore, framing of charge against the applicant nos.5 and 6 herein is bad in eye of law and was not called for.
Therefore, he has prayed for quashing of the aforesaid order dated 08.08.2018 qua the applicant nos.5 & 6 herein.

9. Despite repeated queries made by this Court, learned counsel for opposite party no.2 has failed to point out any allegation against the applicant nos.5 and 6 herein in the FIR as well as from other Rajjak Ali And 5 Ors vs State Of U.P. And Anr on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104573088/
5 material available on record.

entities.text: Rajjak Ali And 5 Ors vs State Of U.P. And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 10. Learned AGA has also not been able to point out any single allegation against the applicant nos.5 and 6 from the entire material available on record.

11. In view thereof, since there is no allegation at all against the applicant nos.5 and 6 herein except a general and vague allegation in the narration of the FIR that the father of the opposite party no.2 has given Rs.2 lacs cash, motorcycle, sofa, double bed, almirah and other articles at the time of marriage on the demand so made by all the applicants herein including applicant nos.5 and 6 herein.

There is not a single allegation against the applicant nos.5 and 6 for any overtact after the marriage with regard to the demand of dowry or torture for demand of dowry of the applicant nos.5 and 6 herein.

12. In view of the considered opinion of this Court, the order framing of charge against the applicant nos.5 and 6 without there being any allegation has been passed by the learned trial court without application of mind, therefore, the same is set aside qua the applicant nos.5 and 6 herein .
13. With the aforesaid observation, the instant application is allowed qua the applicant nos.5 and 6 alone.
14. Since, the instant criminal prosecution is pending since long, the trial court is directed to proceed in the matter expeditiously against other applicants in accordance with law.

Again, an application under Section 482 Cr.P.C No.14280 of 2015 (Fakharuddin and 6 others vs.
State of U.P. and 2 others) was filed, which was dismissed vide order dated 03.01.2018.

12. In view of the considered opinion of this Court, the order framing of charge against the applicant nos.5 and 6 without there being any allegation has been passed by the learned trial court without application of mind, therefore, the same is set aside qua the applicant nos.5 and 6 herein .
13. With the aforesaid observation, the instant application is allowed qua the applicant nos.5 and 6 alone.
14. Since, the instant criminal prosecution is pending since long, the trial court is directed to proceed in the matter expeditiously against other applicants in accordance with law.
